gaunt.definitionKo: 근심이나 병 등으로 얼굴이 많이 상하다.
gaunt.englishDescription: Looking stricken with a disease, worry, etc.

gaunt.definitionKo: 고생을 하거나 병에 걸려서 살이 빠지고 얼굴에 핏기가 없다.
gaunt.englishDescription: Losing weight and looking pale due to suffering or disease.

generalization.definitionKo: 사회에 널리 퍼짐. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
generalization.englishDescription: A state in which something is widespread across the society, or an act of making it prevail across the society.

generalization.definitionKo: 특정한 대상을 전문적으로 자세하게 다루는 것이 아닌, 전체에 널리 통하는 논리나 이론.
generalization.englishDescription: A logic or theory applied broadly across the board, not dealing specifically with a certain subject.

generalization.definitionKo: 개별적인 것이나 특수한 것이 전체에 두루 통하는 것으로 됨. 또는 그렇게 만듦.
generalization.englishDescription: A process in which something individual or specific becomes widely applicable; the act of making such a thing widely applicable.

generalization.definitionKo: 여러 가지 의견이나 사실들에서 공통되고 일반적인 결론을 내림. 또는 그런 방식.
generalization.englishDescription: The act of drawing a general conclusion from several opinions or facts; such a method.

generalization.definitionKo: 각각 떨어져 있는 것들을 한데 모아서 묶음.
generalization.englishDescription: An act of gathering and connecting things scattered here and there.

genuineness.definitionKo: 꾸밈이나 거짓이 없이 자연 그대로 깨끗하고 순진함.
genuineness.englishDescription: The state of being pure and genuine, without hypocrisy or dishonesty.

geobukseon.definitionKo: 조선 시대에 이순신 장군이 왜적의 침입을 물리치기 위해 철판으로 거죽을 싸서 만든 거북 모양의 배.
geobukseon.englishDescription: A unique Korean warship in the shape of a turtle that was covered in hard, metal plates and which was built during the Joseon Dynasty at Admiral Yi Sunsin's command in order to fight the invading Japanese navy.

geudae.englishDescription: (polite form) A pronoun used to indicate the listener.

geudae.definitionKo: (친근하게 이르는 말로) 글에서 상대방을 가리키는 말.
geudae.englishDescription: (affectionate) A pronoun used to indicate the other person in a written document.

gojoseon.definitionKo: 한국 최초의 국가. 기원전 2333년 무렵에 단군왕검이 중국의 요동과 한반도 서북쪽 지역에 세운 나라로, 기원전 108년에 중국 한나라에 멸망하였다.
gojoseon.englishDescription: The first country that existed on the Korean Peninsula; founded in 2333 B.C., by King Dangun across Liaodong of China and northwestern region of the Korean Peninsula, it collapsed because of the Chinese Han in 108 B.C.

gok.definitionKo: 제사나 장례 때 일정한 소리를 내며 욺. 또는 그런 울음.
gok.englishDescription: An act of crying, making a lamenting sound repeatedly in mourning someone's death, or such a cry.

goodwill.definitionKo: 친절한 마음씨. 또는 어떤 대상을 좋게 생각하는 마음.
goodwill.englishDescription: Kind heart or a good feeling toward a certain object.

graceful.englishDescription: Beautiful and pleasing to the eye.

graze.definitionKo: 기르는 동물을 우리에 가두지 않고 사방이 트인 곳에 내놓아 기르다.
graze.englishDescription: To raise livestock in an open place, not confining it in a cage.

graze.definitionKo: 가축을 우리에 가두지 않고 풀밭에 풀어 놓고 기르다.
graze.englishDescription: To tend livestock out loose in a pasture without keeping them in a cage.

graze.definitionKo: 기르는 동물을 우리에 가두지 않고 사방이 트인 곳에 내놓아 기르다.
graze.englishDescription: To raise livestock in an open place, not confining it in a cage.

grouping.englishExpression: forming of a group; grouping; forming of a league
grouping.englishDescription: The act of grouping or banding together.

guardian.definitionKo: 환자나 노약자, 어린이 등을 보호할 책임이 있는 사람.
guardian.englishDescription: A person responsible for taking care of children, the sick or elderly, etc.

guardian.definitionKo: 미성년자에 대해서 법적으로 부모의 권리와 의무를 가지는 사람.
guardian.englishDescription: A person who has legal, parental rights and obligations to a minor.
A person who guards and protects.

guardian.definitionKo: 법률에서, 친권자가 없는 미성년자 등을 보호하며 재산 관리 및 법률 행위를 대리하는 일을 하는 사람.
guardian.englishDescription: In the law, a person who protects minors without parental authority and acts as an agent for them in managing their property and carrying out legal acts.

gwandeungnori.definitionKo: 부처님 오신 날에 등불을 켜서 달아 놓고서 노는 민속놀이.
gwandeungnori.englishDescription: A tradition where people hang lighted lanterns and celebrate Buddha's birthday.

gwanhonsangje.definitionKo: 성년식, 결혼식, 장례식, 제사를 이르는 네 가지 전통 예식.
gwanhonsangje.englishDescription: The four traditional rituals, namely the coming-of-age, marriage, funerals and ancestral rite.

gyoengbuseon.englishDescription: A railway connecting Seoul and Busan.

hahoetal.definitionKo: 하회 별신굿 탈놀이에서 쓰던 나무로 만든 탈.
hahoetal.englishDescription: A wooden mask used in performing Hahoe byeolsingut tallori,  a traditional Korean Hahoe mask dance.

hanji.definitionKo: 닥나무 껍질 등으로 만든 한국 고유의 종이.
hanji.englishDescription: Traditional Korean paper made of the bark of the paper mulberry tree, etc.

hanok.englishDescription: A traditional Korean house or a house built in such a style.

hanteseo.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이 시작되는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
hanteseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle referring to the entity from which a certain act originates.

hen.definitionKo: 날지 못하고 알을 잘 낳으며 고기 맛이 좋아 집에서 기르는 큰 새.
hen.englishDescription: A big bird unable to fly that is raised on a farm since it lays eggs frequently and its meat tastes good.
A hen raised to receive seeds.

heredity.definitionKo: 윗대의 생김새, 성격, 체질 등이 다음 세대에게 전해짐. 또는 그런 현상.
heredity.englishDescription: The state of the appearance, personality, physical constitution, etc., of the preceding generation being passed on to the next generation, or such a phenomenon.

hinduism.definitionKo: 인도의 토착 신앙과 브라만교가 융합한 종교.
hinduism.englishDescription: A religion that combines the indigenous beliefs of India and Brahmanism.

hormone.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분에서 나와 몸 안을 돌면서 다른 조직이나 기관의 활동을 조절하는 물질.
hormone.englishDescription: A substance secreted from one part of a body, which travels across the inside of the body, controlling the activity of another tissue or organ.

identity.definitionKo: 한 나라의 문화나 전통 등의 특색을 나타내는 것.
identity.englishDescription: A thing that shows a country's characteristics such as culture or tradition.

identity.definitionKo: 다른 것과 구별되도록 혼자만 갖고 있는 특별한 성질.
identity.englishDescription: The special quality that is unique to oneself which is distinctive from others.
The identity of a thing or person
The true nature or characteristics of someone or something.

identity.definitionKo: 어떤 존재의 변하지 않는 원래의 특성을 깨닫는 성질. 또는 그 성질을 가진 존재.
identity.englishDescription: The understanding of one's inherent and unchangeable characteristics, or a being with such characteristics.

identity.definitionKo: 개인의 평소 행실이나 직업 등과 같은 정보.
identity.englishDescription: Information about an individual, such as his/her regular behavior, occupation, etc.

image.definitionKo: 영화, 텔레비전 등의 화면에 나타나는 모습.
image.englishDescription: A picture shown on the screen of a film, TV, etc.
The shape of an object that is thought in one's head.
The shape of an object that appears to one's eyes.

image.definitionKo: 물체에서 나온 빛이 렌즈나 거울 등에 비쳐서 나타나는 모양.
image.englishDescription: The image created by an object's light being reflected from a lens or mirror, etc.

image.definitionKo: 믿음이나 의미를 담아 나무, 돌, 흙 등으로 만든 형상.
image.englishDescription: A shape made of wood, stones, soil, etc., containing belief or meaning.
A peculiar mood or flair felt in a person.
The form or state of an object.

image.definitionKo: 텔레비전, 컴퓨터, 휴대 전화 등의 화면에 나타나는 모양.
image.englishDescription: The appearance on the screen of a television, computer, mobile phone, etc.

image.definitionKo: 한 폭의 그림이나 사진이 채우고 있는 면.
image.englishDescription: The space filled by a picture or photo.

image.definitionKo: 영화가 비치는 막이나 텔레비전 따위에 나타나는 영상, 또는 그 영상이 나타나는 면.
image.englishDescription: A video image appearing on the movie screen or television; or the screen that contains such an image.

immaturity.definitionKo: 정신적, 육체적으로 아직 다 자라지 못함. 또는 경험이 충분하지 못하여 어떤 것에 익숙하지 못한 상태.
immaturity.englishDescription: The state of being not yet full-grown mentally or physically; the state of being inexperienced and thus being not familiar with something.

importer.definitionKo: 다른 나라로부터 물품 등을 사들여 오는 장사. 또는 그런 장사를 하는 사람.
importer.englishDescription: A trade that involves purchasing goods, etc., from foreign countries, or a person in such a business.

impugnation.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 비난하거나 다른 의견에 반대하며 나섬.
impugnation.englishDescription: The act of criticizing someone or opposing other opinions.

impure.englishDescription: A substance, etc., not being pure.

incapableness.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 행동 등을 할 수 없음.
incapableness.englishDescription: Lack of ability to do something.

insipid.definitionKo: 음식이 제맛이 나지 않고 몹시 싱겁다.
insipid.englishDescription: Food being very bland, not tasting good

insist.englishDescription: Not give up one's own opinion.
To insist or promote a certain fact in public.
To insist on one's opinion or position over and over.

insist.definitionKo: 억지를 부려 자기의 의견이나 뜻을 고집스럽게 내세우다.
insist.englishDescription: To assert one's opinion or will in a persistent manner.
To keep insisting one's opinion, argument, etc.

interaction.definitionKo: 서로 오고 감. 또는 소식이나 정보를 주고받음.
interaction.englishDescription: The act of coming and going; or the act of exchanging news or information with one another.

interaction.definitionKo: 짝을 이루거나 관계를 맺고 있는 이쪽과 저쪽 사이에서 이루어지는 작용.
interaction.englishDescription: An action taking place between both sides in a relationship or pair.

internalization.definitionKo: 마음속에 깊이 자리 잡힘. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
internalization.englishDescription: A process in which something takes a deep root in one's mind, or an act of making this happen.

interrogate.definitionKo: 정확한 법적 판결을 위해 관계자를 상대로 사건에 대해 캐물으며 조사하다.
interrogate.englishDescription: To question inquisitively and investigate people concerned regarding a certain incident for an accurate legal decision.

interrogate.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 사건과 관련된 사람에게 자세하게 따져서 묻다.
interrogate.englishDescription: To ask detailed questions of someone related to a certain incident or accident.
To say something, demanding an answer or explanation.
To ask a question to find out something.
To find out someone's wrongdoing through close questioning.
To find out an unrevealed fact.
To persistently ask questions in detail.
To persistently ask questions in detail.

intestines.definitionKo: 우리 몸에서 음식물의 소화와 흡수를 담당하는 소장과 대장.
intestines.englishDescription: The small and large intestines in the human body which are responsible for digestion and absorption.
The big and small intestines of a human or animal.

invigorant.definitionKo: 몸의 기운을 높여 주고 건강하도록 도와주는 약.
invigorant.englishDescription: A medicine that helps make one healthy and vigorous.

iya.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize the preceding word.

jageunbuk.englishDescription: small drum; tabor: A small-sized drum.

jarak.englishDescription: song; tune: A unit for counting the number of songs or tunes.

jeoreomyeonseo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '저리하면서' (a conjugated form of '저리하다' (do that)).

jjongmaru.definitionKo: 건물의 바깥쪽 둘레를 감싸고 있는 기둥의 밖으로 덧붙여 달아 낸 마루.
jjongmaru.englishDescription: Narrow wooden veranda: a type of traditional Korean veranda made up of floorboards, protruding outside the boundary of a house marked by its pillars.

jolt.englishDescription: To affect something or someone greatly.
To shake something to move it; for something to shake and move.

jolt.definitionKo: 크고 두툼한 물건이 세게 움직이는 소리가 자꾸 나다.
jolt.englishDescription: For sounds to be made repeatedly, as big and thick objects strongly move.

jolt.definitionKo: 크고 두툼한 물건이 세게 움직이는 소리가 나다.
jolt.englishDescription: For a sound to be made as a big and thick object strongly moves.

kickball.definitionKo: 규칙은 야구와 비슷한데, 공을 방망이 대신 발로 차서 승부를 겨루는 경기.
kickball.englishDescription: A sports game with rules similar to baseball, but, in which a ball is kicked, not hit.

killing.englishDescription: The act of killing a person.
An act of killing people or animals indiscriminately.
An act of killing a person.
An act of killing a living thing.

knapsack.definitionKo: 스님들이 등에 지고 다니는 자루 모양의 큰 주머니.
knapsack.englishDescription: A big, sack-shaped pocket that Buddhist monks carry on their shoulders.

knapsack.definitionKo: 물건을 넣어 등에 멜 수 있도록 만든 가방.
knapsack.englishDescription: A bag for putting in objects, made to carry on one's shoulders.

knead.definitionKo: 손으로 몸을 두드리거나 주물러서 근육의 긴장을 풀어주다.
knead.englishDescription: To relax muscles by patting or kneading the body with the hands.

knead.definitionKo: 가루에 물을 넣고 섞어 개어 놓다.
knead.englishDescription: To mix powder with water and soften the mass.
To knead grain powder and make it into food.

knead.definitionKo: 반죽한 재료를 주무르고 다듬어서 어떤 것을 만들어 내다.
knead.englishDescription: To make something by kneading dough, etc.

knead.definitionKo: 흙이나 가루 등에 물을 부어 반죽하다.
knead.englishDescription: To make dough or paste by mixing soil, powder, etc., with water.

knead.definitionKo: 손으로 어떤 물건이나 몸을 쥐었다 놓았다 하면서 자꾸 만지다.
knead.englishDescription: To keep touching a thing or body part with one's hand by repeating the act of grabbing and releasing.

knead.definitionKo: 빨래나 반죽 등을 어떤 것에 대고 자꾸 문지르다.
knead.englishDescription: To rub laundry, dough, etc., repeatedly against something.
To repeat the act of grabbing and releasing an object or body part.
To keep repeating the act of grabbing and releasing an object or body part.

knockdown.definitionKo: 권투에서, 한 선수가 상대 선수에게 맞고 쓰러짐.
knockdown.englishDescription: In a boxing match, a state in which a boxer falls down after being struck by his/her opponent.

landslide.englishDescription: An act of winning the competition, election, etc. by a large margin.

landslide.definitionKo: 산이나 언덕의 흙 또는 쌓인 눈 등이 비바람 같은 충격을 받아 한꺼번에 무너져 내리는 일.
landslide.englishDescription: A sudden, simultaneous collapse of soil or snow piled up on a mountain due to heavy rain, etc.

landslide.definitionKo: 큰비나 지진, 화산 등으로 산에서 돌과 흙이 한꺼번에 무너져 내리는 일.
landslide.englishDescription: A sudden collapse of rocks and soil all together on a mountain due to heavy rain, an earthquake, volcanic eruption, etc.

learner.englishDescription: A person who studies in a school.
A person who learns by studying something.

lightning.definitionKo: 구름과 구름 또는 구름과 땅 사이에서 반대되는 전기를 띤 입자들이 부딪쳐서 순간적으로 일어나는 강한 빛.
lightning.englishDescription: A strong light flashing for a split second in the sky, along with the sound of thunder when it rains.

lightning.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 동작이 아주 재빠르고 날랜 사람이나 사물.
lightning.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who is very quick and deft in action.

lightning.definitionKo: 하늘에서 큰 소리를 내며 번쩍이는 빛의 줄기가 내리치는 자연 현상.
lightning.englishDescription: A natural phenomenon where a flash of light occurs in the sky accompanied by a loud boom.
The light that flashes during a thunderstorm.
A light that flashes during a stroke of lightning.

loathing.englishDescription: A feeling of intense hatred and resentment.
A feeling of intense hatred and resentment.

low-priced.englishDescription: The cost for buying or using something being low.

lukewarmness.definitionKo: 온도가 미지근하거나 태도가 소극적임. 또는 그런 온도나 태도.
lukewarmness.englishDescription: A temperature being not warm enough or an attitude being passive; such a temperature or attitude.

make-believe.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 거짓을 사실인 것처럼 보이게 하기 위한 말이나 행동.
make-believe.englishDescription: An art in which an actor performs an event or character on stage according to a script through words and actions.

manure.definitionKo: 식물이 잘 자라도록 땅에 뿌리거나 섞는 물질.
manure.englishDescription: Substance scattered over or mixed into the soil for plants to grow well.

manure.definitionKo: 풀, 짚 또는 가축의 똥과 오줌 등을 썩힌 거름.
manure.englishDescription: Manure made of rotting grass, straw, the excrement and urine of animals, etc.

manure.definitionKo: 풀, 짚 또는 가축의 똥과 오줌 등을 썩힌 거름.
manure.englishDescription: Fertilizer that is made from the dung and urine of livestock, or from decomposing grass, hay, etc.

me.definitionKo: 말하는 사람이 듣는 사람에게 자신을 낮추어 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: The humble form used by the speaker to refer to himself/herself for the purpose of showing humility to the listener.

me.definitionKo: (낮추는 말로) 아들이 부모에게 자기를 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: (impolite form) A word used by a son to refer to himself in talking to his parents.

me.definitionKo: (옛날에) 결혼하지 않은 여자가 윗사람에게 자기를 낮추어 이르는 말.
me.englishDescription: (archaic) A word used by an unmarried woman to address herself humbly to a person who is older than her.

me.definitionKo: (옛날에) 신하가 임금에게 자기를 낮추어 이르던 말.
me.englishDescription: (archaic) A word used by a subject to address himself/herself humbly to his/her king.

me.definitionKo: (낮추는 말로) 남자가 윗사람에게 자기를 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: (impolite form) A pronoun that is used to indicate the speaker himself while speaking to a person senior to him.

me.definitionKo: (옛날에) 결혼한 여자가 윗사람에게 자신을 낮추어 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: (archaic) A word used by a married woman to address herself humbly to an older person.

me.definitionKo: (낮추는 말로) 신분이 낮은 사람이 자기보다 신분이 높은 사람에게 자기를 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: (impolite form) A term used by a person to address himself/herself to another who is higher in status .

me.definitionKo: (낮추는 말로) 아들이 부모에게 자기를 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: (impolite form) A term used by a son to address himself to his parents.

me.definitionKo: 공식적인 자리에서 말하는 사람이 자기를 가리키는 말.
me.englishDescription: A word used by a speaker when he/she refers to himself/herself in an official setting.

snake.definitionKo: 몸이 원통형으로 가늘고 길며 다리가 없고 피부가 비늘로 덮여 있는 파충류의 동물.
snake.englishDescription: A limbless reptile that has a cylindrical, long, slender body and scaly skin.

snaky.definitionKo: 겉으로는 부드럽고 솔직한 척하나 속은 음흉하다.
snaky.englishDescription: Pretending to be tender and frank but actually being wicked.

sopor.englishDescription: A state of being fast asleep.

sprinkler.definitionKo: 물을 흩어서 뿌리는 기구. 주로 잔디에 물을 주거나 건물 안의 불을 끄는 데 사용한다.
sprinkler.englishDescription: A device that scatters and sprays water; it is mainly used to water the lawn or put out fires in buildings.

squash.englishDescription: A type of squash that is cucumber-shaped, green and eaten when immature.

To press and squeeze hard ruthlessly.

squash.definitionKo: 마구 눌러서 여기저기 고르지 않게 주름이 잡히게 하여 줄어들게 하다.
squash.englishDescription: To reduce something by pressing it hard so that it forms many uneven wrinkles.

squash.definitionKo: 마구 눌러서 여기저기 고르지 않게 주름이 잡혀 줄어들게 하다.

stenography.definitionKo: 부호를 사용하여 남의 말을 빨리 받아 적는 일. 또는 그런 기록.
stenography.englishDescription: An act of quickly taking down another person's statement using symbols, or such a record.

sterilize.definitionKo: 병에 걸리는 것을 막기 위해 약품이나 열 등으로 균을 죽이다.
sterilize.englishDescription: To destroy germs with chemicals, heat, etc., in order to prevent one's getting sick.

sterilize.definitionKo: 약품이나 열 등을 이용해 세균을 죽여 없애다.
sterilize.englishDescription: To kill germs through chemicals, heat, etc.

stickily.definitionKo: 끈기가 있는 물질이 있어 피부에 들러붙는 느낌이 있게.
stickily.englishDescription: With a feeling that a gluey substance sticks to the skin.

stockpile.definitionKo: 만약의 경우를 대비하여 미리 모아 둠.
stockpile.englishDescription: An act of saving something ahead of time in preparation for an emergency.

stumbling.definitionKo: 이쪽 저쪽으로 돌아가며 사람이나 사물을 분별없이 치고받고 부딪히는 것.

stunting.englishDescription: The act of doing disservice by blocking and hindering something.

superglue.definitionKo: 나무, 가죽, 고무 등의 물체를 붙이기 위해 쓰는 물질.
superglue.englishDescription: A substance used to solidly bond together pieces of wood, leather, rubber, etc.

superior.definitionKo: 조직 내에서 자기보다 직급이 높은 사람.

therefore.definitionKo: 앞의 내용이 뒤의 내용의 원인이나 근거, 조건 등이 될 때 쓰는 말.

therefore.englishDescription: On this account; for this reason; due to this.

thrift.definitionKo: 일이나 살림을 규모 있고 계획성 있게 하여 빈틈이 없음.
thrift.englishDescription: The state of keeping the economy of one's household thoroughly and as planned.

thug.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 말투나 행동의 수준이 낮고 천하며 특별한 직업 없이 못된 짓을 하고 다니는 사람.
thug.englishDescription: (slang) A person who talks and acts in a vulgar manner, and engages in misdemeanor without having any particular occupation.

timing.definitionKo: 좋은 결과를 얻기 위한 적절한 시기.

urbanization.definitionKo: 도시의 문화가 전해져서 도시가 아닌 곳이 도시처럼 됨. 또는 그렇게 만듦.
urbanization.englishDescription: A place that is not a city becoming urban with the spread of urban culture, or a locale caused to become urban.

vanguard.definitionKo: 맨 앞에 서거나 제일 먼저 어떤 일을 하는 부대나 무리.
